breakDiscardCleanupContract.method: Keep the primary connected character plus the beam pieces held by its hands; remove the separate projectile entering from screen-left, then remove detached gray smoke and small wood-debris components in the projectile trajectory ROI.
breakDiscardCleanupContract.protection: Do not remove the intact held beam before the break or either of the two hand-held broken pieces before their release.

beamAttackCleanupContract.method: After BiRefNet, preserve the primary character-plus-held-beam component and remove the small detached rectangular wood component ahead of the beam tip in the contact interval.
beamAttackCleanupContract.protection: Never shorten, reshape or erase the connected held beam; the v02 source keeps the complete attack silhouette inside the canvas.
